reviews.text: I really like this clinic they were very nice, attentive and pretty affordable. I like where you drop your pet off and they do the examination and treatmenta and you pick up after.  Dr Smith was very nice and was able to diagnose the real problem when other vets could not.
Dr. Darrell and the girls at Clay Road are great. Highly recommend!
Dr Smith is connected to animals, you can see it in his eyes and caring gift.  I am thankful for him, he’s a gift to us all from God🙏 …
Great Veterinarian! And nice Staff!

A friend referred me this clinic and i came all the way from the other side of the city but unfortunately we didn’t have good experience
We waited more than one hour in the room and nobody cared. They charge high prices but no service
I don’t recommend this place at all
After 1hour and half waiting they said you need reschedule
Soooo sad
I never go back here

Very professional, they treat pets with care. In my case, I took my dog ​​in for a cyst on her paw and a lump on her abdomen (it turned out to be a fatty deposit). After the examination... surgery! The doctor mentioned that since she was going to be anesthetized, he could cauterize a small lump on her eye. Oh my god, we hadn't even thought of that! But he obviously examined her very thoroughly, so it was a 3-for-1 deal. The price seemed very fair to me, because it also included post-operative medications. I'm very happy with the care my pet received, the attention and explanations we got, and the price.

Hands down, I have met no other veterinarian as wonderful as Dr. Smith. He’s been caring for our pets for over a decade, and I cannot fathom taking my cats/dogs anywhere else.

Pros:
*Dr. Smith is smart, patient, and kind. He listens and communicates clearly and compassionately. He doesn’t talk over your head or talk down to you, which can be a difficult balance.

*His prices can’t be beat. You can tell this clinic is run by someone who prioritizes a love for animals, not a love for money. (Bonus: if  you pay with cash, you’ll save the 3% credit card fee)

Other:
*The building is a little older and not as shiny/glossy as some vet clinics. You want a shiny vet clinic? Feel free to go pay three times as much somewhere with vets who don’t care for your babies with a fraction of the heart Dr. Smith and his staff has.

*Appointment times can be a little imprecise. Your appointment might be at 2 but you’re not seen until 3. Remember this is a one doc practice. Sometimes the best is worth waiting for. If someone else’s pet needs a little extra TLC, they deserve to recieve it, so you wait. When the tables are turned and your own pet needs a little extra love, you appreciate that others are willing to wait as well.

* There are several kitties in residence. Some are as sweet as can be. Others are a little spicy and take some warming up to, but if you know how to approach cats (slowly and with deference), they’ll warm up in no time. Just remember they are animals with their own personalities, not plushies there for your amusement. Be smart.

* Reaching the clinic by phone can sometimes be a challenge. Leave a voicemail. They’ll call back. A few years ago, the staff returning calls was inconsistent. Recently I’ve found they always call back the same day, usually within a few hours.

While I’d like to keep this hidden gem hidden, I must speak the truth! Even if money were no object, you will not find a better vet. Period.

so, I guess they are ok? never saw the vet or at least no one ever introduced themselves. they never explained procedures, never asked about problem (beyond what I told them when I made appt). they took my dog back and them came back with meds for diarrhea and an antibiotic. My dog never had diarrhea. just a tinge of bright red blood in her stool. I called, left VM and no one ever called me back so I drove over to get an appt. the cat on the counter bit me, no big deal, but kind of odd. their pricing is very reasonable, but wish they would have talked to me before treating my dog. strange care to treat animal before asking owner for specifics.

**Edit 7/28/26. Changed to 5 star, as Owner called to discuss review, and we had a great conversation. It says a lot about the care they provide. We had some miscommunication, but I appreciate the Clinic taking time to call me back, and would return. I was not asked at any point to change my review from 4 starts to 5, that was my decision.
I had my male cat fixed and all went well!
Absolutely love this vet!

Dr. Smith is so very awesome. He is great with the animals and addresses all cares and concerns that you have for your fur babies. I will definitely continue to bring my dogs and cats to him. Today he handled my 5 kittens with love and compassion! Great veterinary clinic!
Always great, love the doctor.

The whole staff was so friendly and helpful. Dr. Smith was just wonderful! You could tell he cared and made my normally anxious dog feel so comfortable. Officially my fur babies' new doctor.  Thank you to the entire team at Clay Road Animal Clinic!

Very kind and reasonable prices
Will not do unnecessary procedures

Dr Smith has been my family's vet for years! He takes excellent care of my two girl pugs. Very adorable prices and gets you in and out if your only their for the yearly shots. I drive in from Humble to take my pugs. We love Dr. Smith.
The Doctor literally saved my animal's life 7 months ago and today we had an Annual evaluation and everything went smoothly. He really cares for the animals and is extremely professional.
I'm so glad I took my dog ​​to them. The doctor is wonderful and the staff is very attentive. Thank you for your service!
The doctor is always very pleasant, great with the animals, and explains everything well. Appreciate always seeing the same doctor. The staff assisting him are very good too.

I’d really appreciate if this place of business could answer their phone in order to properly schedule appointments for my pets and get info on what they need updated. I can NEVER get ahold of anybody here ever. Seriously you need to consider fixing this as it’s clearly an ongoing issue with other people too based on reviews. I can’t even get my dogs vaccines sent to me in a time of need. Ridiculous.
Very professional and friendly, I've been bringing my dog for like 9  years and they're always happy to answer my questions. Only bad thing is they're closed in the weekend 😭

I have been bringing my fur babies here for 20 yrs!! They are the BEST and it's so hard to find any vet with a genuine gift with animals!! My dogs and cats LOVE Dr. Smith and his staff. My newest baby Eva enjoys her visits and just.finished all her puppy shots. I moved to cut and shoot but STILL drive for this vet.
A great Dr!! Happy to take my baby to him!!
They are very kind...I feel comfortable taking my dogs there.

I brought my dog in for some surgery to remove a tumor and dropped her off on I believe a Tuesday and paid for the surgery. No problem. I was told to come back in 2 weeks on a Wednesday for the stitches to be removed. My appointment was at 12:00. I arrived at 12 and was put into a room. I waited and waited then Dr. Smith and his assistant finally came in. My room was facing the parking lot. While I was waiting, one vehicle left with their dog and 3 more pulled in, brought their dogs in and left. I asked why I was waiting an hour to see him. His response was to hold his hands out to the side and say jokingly, you haven't been here an hour. I said, you're right, I've only been here 55 minutes. He threw his hands up in the air and said, "Well I guess it's time for you to find another vet" and walked out of the room. I was left there with my mouth open with the assistant. To this day I don't know what happened in the surgery, what was removed, where there any problems, what to do for after care, did I need another appointment, nothing. Thankfully the assistant removed the stitches. I told the assistant that I wanted to see him and sat in that room for another hour and he never came back. I even asked 2 other girls working there to see him. We have been going here since he first bought the clinic from the previous vet. So, probably more than 20 years.  We used to think super highly about Dr. Smith. But, after that adolescent outburst and the way we were treated, we will never step foot in there again. I value my best friends health way to much to take a chance over there again. The pricing was starting to go all over the place too. One visit we were charged $45 and the next $85 for the same thing. One time $55 and the next time $165 for the same thing. If you bring your fur babies in and are left sitting forever, don't say anything or you might get the same outburst. I was left sitting for 1 1/2 hours on another visit and 1 hour on another visit prior to this. I just didn't say anything. And, if you ever need to call, the ringer is off because they never answer the phone. 3 dog trainers that I know said they will never refer anyone there again and that I should report this to the vet board of Texas. I did not do that out of respect for the many years of good service from prior visits.

We love our new vet. It's a great and easy location to get to. It's not an overwhelming waiting room like many vet clinics, appointments are made and kept and seen to with ease. Pricing is very fair! The techs and ladies there are friendly and do their jobs well. Dr. Smith is a very caring, practical and understanding vet who puts the patient before the profit and is a great person.

I’ve been coming to this clinic for around 11 years. I originally had a 5-star review because the doctor truly helped my animals many times. He is good, honest, doesn’t try to upsell unnecessary treatments, and I always appreciated that.

So why did I change my review to 2 stars?

Because in 11 years, nothing has improved.
•	They almost never answer the phone, and when they do, it’s usually 2–3 hours later.
•	To schedule an appointment, you generally need to wait at least a week.
•	Even when you have an appointment, expect to wait 45–60 minutes before being seen.

The last time I visited, I politely mentioned that I had already waited 25 minutes and that I needed to get to work. Instead of understanding, the doctor got upset, spoke with attitude, and slammed the door. Later he tried to soften the situation, but there was no apology, and for me, that mattered. Respect goes both ways.

I don’t enjoy lowering my rating after so many years, but this experience, along with the lack of improvement in the clinic’s operations, made me feel it was necessary to be honest—both for other clients and for the clinic to hopefully improve.

I really love brining my dog to this clinic! Ollito is well taken care of and the doctor is so kind, patient and knowledgeable. I like that the clinic is privately owned because the doctor shows so  much empathy and he’s not constantly trying to up-charge to meet quotas. I also come to this clinic to buy my pet safe candles which smell so good and my paw spray. I never let my dog walk in my house after being outside without using this spray. It’s an antimicrobial spray and I feel better about letting my dog on my furniture because I know his paws are cleaned.
Very good with our dogs.
Dr. Smith is the absolute best. He's seen me through some tuff times and takes great care of my baby. I've been going to him for over 20 years.

I have been coming here for 10 years. This place has gone downhill so bad. I have had experiences where i’ve had an appointment at 1 and the vet comes in at 4 and rushes the appointment. I came today at 12 while my appointment was at 12:30, and left at 1:40 without seeing the doctor because they’re just playing in peoples time. If it is an appointment only based system then stick to the appointment times. Another thing is the room was dirty. The floor, the examination table, I can’t even express how disappointed I am that I won’t be coming back even though Dr. Smith helped my cats in the past. They never answer the phones anyway, always straight to voicemail regardless of how many times you call. and they’re always booked for weeks in advance and say they’re always busy, and yet the clinic is so quiet and so empty that i can hear staff talking or whispering. I’ve also seen many other reviews stating the same thing and yet no changes. Do yourself a favor, look for another vet.
Prompt and courteous service. Friendly staff

Update: I had to find another vet because this one never answers their phone and most recently, they didn't bother returning my call. The last time I came they also informed me they don't take walkins and their schedule was about a week behind. Not ideal for old pups like mine. I was happy with the Dr but being ignored when my pup is elderly and sick is not ok.

4 years ago: So glad I found them. Pricing is reasonable and unlike other vets they got the diagnosis and treatment right the first time.
Reasonably priced practical care. They dont try to upsell unnecessary services or products. Staff is friendly and good with animals.

The staff was friendly and the Veterinarian took good care of my cat by removing a tumor on my kitties stomach. His price was very affordable considering the surgery needed. I was only charged $350. As to another vet clinic I took her before wanted THREE THOUSAND! There prices were ridiculous. Thank you Clay Animal Clinic for your kindness and care for my cat.
We appreciate your 5-star rating. Thank you for your feedback.

Our 2 year Frenchie Toby suddenly could not walk with his hind legs. Dr. Smith immediately x-rayed and determined my boy needed to heal from a common problem Frenchie's suffer if they pull a muscle from jumping for balls etc. He insisted we leave him to heal properly because any excitement of jumping would extend his healing process. My Toby healed and he's back to normal. I cried of happiness just thinking he could have to wear a back harness with wheels to move around if he did not heal properly. We are so grateful at how he treated him with tender loving care and compassion as it was his own fur baby. We have also taken our Maltipoo and receive the same care. This Dr.'s office is really busy, so be patient, leave a message if they don't answer and they will call you back as soon as they can.
Absolutely the most amazing vet ever! I adore Dr Smith and his love for animals!

I have been using Clay Animal Clinic for 15-years with my cats. Although I truly love Dr. Smith, his front office staff sucks!!!! He goes through so many staff employees at his clinic, should give a clue.  No one ever answers the phone, I am lucky after leaving a voice mail, I may, or may not get a call back. Dr. Smith is a great Vet but I would NOT recommend Clay Animal Clinic. Sorry to say, because I loved Dr. Smith

I wish I could give a minus one-star review based on the appalling treatment I received on June 30, 2025. The person I spoke with did not identify themselves, and I refuse to make assumptions about their role. I moved to Texas four years ago, and my family, who have been long-time patients of Dr. Smith, highly recommended him. They have always praised his care.

I brought my then 22-year-old cat and my two new dogs to him without any issues and trusted him completely because of the compassion he previously showed to me and my pets. However, after my experience yesterday, I will not return.

Dr. Smith, you have lost a customer because your front office staff is unacceptable. They do not answer the phones, and when they do, they are cold, detached, and lacking in compassion. My now 25-year-old cat was in decline, and I did not want him to suffer in his final hours. I urgently needed Dr. Smith's help to assist with his passing.

I called three times and received no response. On the fourth call, the person I spoke to was not only rude and dismissive but also condescending. When I explained my situation and expressed my desire to euthanize my cat, she bluntly informed me that there were no appointments available and that the soonest I could be seen would be July 14th. I made it clear that my cat would not make it to July 14th and emphasized that this was an emergency. Her response—that this is not an emergency veterinary practice—was utterly heartless.

Dr. Smith, it is imperative that you reassess your front office staff; they are damaging your reputation. During my past appointments, I was the only one in the waiting room, despite claims that you are booked weeks in advance. If your practice is indeed that busy, you should seriously consider hiring another veterinarian to manage the overflow.

Ultimately, I took my cat to Affordable Pet Care as a walk-in. They exceeded my expectations with their compassion and genuine concern. They apologized sincerely for the poor treatment I received and did not make me wait in a crowded waiting room. Instead, they ushered us in immediately and allowed me as much time as I needed to say goodbye. I felt heard and supported in the loss of my beloved cat.

A veterinarian should provide care from cradle to grave, and there must always be availability for urgent visits, whether it involves euthanasia or a minor issue. Dr. Smith, it’s crucial that you change your front office staff; they are seriously undermining your good name and reputation.
Great customer service. Will be back.
Best vet ever! Compassionate, always answers questions. Very competitive prices. Sometimes difficult to schedule a visit, but worth your patience.

The only reason I am giving a 1 star is because of the staff employee Vanessa.  Very Rude, no compassion for my dog.
I called for several days to try to get an appointment, but they never answer their phone's.  I left several messages and also tried to get an appointment on the website.  Again, no one returned my calls or answered (no reply) the request on the website.  I decided to go to the clinic to get my dog seen asap,   Vanessa had no compassion for my dog nor did she even ask what the issue was, all she said was she was too busy to answer the phone (there was also another staff member sitting at the front desk doing nothing and only ONE person waiting to see the doctor) Vanessa said if you have an emergency go to the emergency animal clinic.  I indicated it was not yet an emergency but could result in one if I can't get my dog an appointment.   She said very coldly the soonest she could schedule him was a week and half away.  I asked if she could PLEASE ask Dr Smith if he could see him after his last appointment that I would wait.   She again very coldly said NO the soonest she would see him was a week and half away.  It was such a traumatic experience; I will never go back again because of Vanessa.    Dr. Smith you need to review what your website says, "Staff is compassionate and caring" This is not true with Vanessa!  Only 1 person was waiting in the lobby to see the vet.
I got a recommendation from a friend for another VET clinic, and they got him in right away as a walk-in.  Staff at my dog's new VET is VERY Compassionate and VERY Caring and the Vet was just as wonderful!  I am happy to say my dog has a New Vet now.
I like this Veterinarian.
Best vet in town!!
Friendly staff.
I wish I could give no stars, worst place ever!!! especially Jennifer she's so rude and  she has the worst attitude!!!

Dr. Smith is a good doctor, however one of the front desk ladies is incredibly rude and has a terrible attitude every time I've talked to her. I specifically requested to get the blanket I carried my dead pup in returned to me, only to find out she threw the blanket away instead. Been coming here since 2011, very disappointed
Dr. Smith is great. He is a patient and caring about the animals. I really trust him.

While the vet is wonderful and provided excellent care for my pet, the customer service is absolutely terrible. The biggest issue is that they never answer the phone. I would try calling multiple times with no luck, which made scheduling appointments or getting any information incredibly difficult. It would get to the point if I needed something I would have to drive to the clinic to find to girls behind the desk with phones clearly right in front of them. They often times had an attitude and seemed bothered when I had questions about my animal who was experiencing frequent seizures. It’s frustrating when you can’t get through to speak with someone and when you do they are rude, especially when your pet’s health is involved. The day my kitty passed away i tried calling them several times for help and once again I couldn’t get through. I will never bring another animal here again!!!

Clay road animal clinic has always been a dependable vet clinic for all my pets. They are also affordable and have never had a crazy price increase. They have always been respectful of my time and that’s important to me. When I set an appointment, I’m usually taken care of at that time and out within 45 mins.

I've been taking my two dogs here since I moved to the area.  So glad I found such a good vet.  Dr. Smith and staff are great with the animals and owners.  All around a terrific animal clinic.

2025 Update: Still an awesome Veterinarian!
We love taking our pets here. Very reasonable prices and great customer service. If you can’t get them on the phone leave a message, they always get back in a timely manner. Highly recommended!
Nice people
They are the worst when it comes to picking up the phone honestly! How can I get my babies if you never pick up the phone and don’t return voicemails.
Dr.  Smith is the absolute best!

I've been taking my cat to Clay Road Animal Clinic since August 2018 and ever since COVID, they have really fell apart on their attentiveness. They don't call me back after I call 6 or 7 times daily, they don't email me back after they say …
